digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-2 prerequisite_verify gate; code-review Gerrit LLM-Review gate
propositions: Native structured output routing for sonnet-4-6 and haiku models sends JSON schemas to Bedrock exceeding the 180-second grammar-compilation timeout and 24-optional-parameter complexity cap, returning HTTP 400 ValidationException

Plan-review and code-review verify steps fail with `Grammar compilation timed out` or `Schema is too complex` errors at 180.6-185.9 seconds, degrading all findings to no-verification and leaving reviews unsigned

The installed botocore version (1.40.61 on main) rejects native structured-output requests client-side in 0.0s with `Unknown parameter: outputConfig` before reaching Bedrock, and newer botocore (1.43.64+) reaches the server-side timeout instead

Output mode selection must gate native structured output on both stack capability (whether outputConfig is supported) and schema complexity (optional parameter count and union type count), not model capability alone

The complexity bound must recursively count optional parameters in nested objects via $defs, items, and nested properties, not only top-level properties, to correctly score verification contracts at 22-36 optionals
